name: Wish a Wish
source:
Discover an ordinary boy's extraordinary fate as he encounters a magical body pillow, facing life-altering choices in this captivating visual novel. Engaging story, stunning visuals, meaningful choices, and immersive relationships await in 'Wish a Wish'.

[from [url=https://hurrycatstudios.itch.io/wishawish]itch.io[/url]]
